meta.note: STARTER reference dataset for Black Chapel Studios Ski Designer. Specs (tip-waist-tail in mm, radius in m per length in cm) are compiled from public manufacturer/retailer sources for DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY and are approximate - verify against official specs before relying on them. Widths are given per model (they vary only slightly across lengths); radius is per length. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any manufacturer; brand and model names are used nominatively to identify the skis.
meta.schema: each ski: { brand, model, year, category, tip, waist, tail, lengths:[{l, r}] }
